
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xingce/p/22334867" title="发布于 2026-08-08 14:19">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于MPSOC FPGA + NIVIDIA ORIN NX 的CoaXPress 采集</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p><strong><strong><strong>基于MPSOC FPGA + NIVIDIA ORIN NX 的CoaXPress 采集</strong></strong></strong></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><strong><strong>背景说明</strong></strong></strong></li>
</ol>
<p>客户现有验证平台是基于 XILINX MPSoCs ZU19EG以及集成 NVIDIA ORIN NX 8GB模块的开发平台，计划在该平台验证其CoaXPress 相机图像采集与图像处理。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747207/202608/2747207-20260808141447237-1190746846.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>星测电子在基于自有产品JetKU-CXP1004与标准GenTL GenICam 软件ImgGrab 基础之上，快速为客户进行了验证。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747207/202608/2747207-20260808141448723-1217075869.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>图 1-1&nbsp;FMC-CXP-4R CoaXPress 2.0子卡 <a href="https://img-grab.com/productinfo/258920.html" title="FMC-CXP-4R 4通道CoaXPress FMC子卡-重庆星测电子科技有限责任公司" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">FMC-CXP-4R 4通道CoaXPress FMC子卡-重庆星测电子科技有限责任公司</a></p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747207/202608/2747207-20260808141450313-670995262.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>图 1-2&nbsp;JetKU-CXP4001 异构AI开发平台 <a href="https://img-grab.com/productinfo/306297.html" title="JetKU-CXP1004 嵌入式Jetson CoaXPress AI计算平台-重庆星测电子科技有限责任公司" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">JetKU-CXP1004 嵌入式Jetson CoaXPress AI计算平台-重庆星测电子科技有限责任公司</a></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong><strong><strong>硬件准备</strong></strong></strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>ALINX Z19-M MPSOC+ORIN NX 8GB 模组</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>星测电子FMC-CXP-4R</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>星测电子CXP软件系统</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>MIKROTRON’s 25CXP+ high‐speed CMOS cameras</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ubuntu22.04</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>ImgGrab V1.0.3 <a href="https://img-grab.com/jszc" title="重庆星测电子科技有限责任公司-下载" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">重庆星测电子科技有限责任公司-下载</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747207/202608/2747207-20260808141452102-1754008653.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><strong><strong>测试步骤</strong></strong></strong></li>
</ol>
<p>1、做好硬件连接，上电之前，连接好FMC-CXP-4R子卡与相机，连接网线到jetson，与windows 计算机在同一个局域网</p>
<p>2、打开设备电源进入jetson ubuntu 系统，账号alinx，密码root，由于当前系统从SD卡启动，PCIe再开机第一次无法正确识别，需要reboot 软重启一次</p>
<p>3、windows 计算机下载 HelloFPGARuntimeXXX安装包，下载ImgGrab安装包安装，地址 <a href="https://img-grab.com/jszc" title="Chongqing Xingce Electronic Technology Co Ltd.-Download " target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Chongqing Xingce Electronic Technology Co Ltd.-Download</a></p>
<p>4、在jetson linux系统中运行DDA-HelloFPGA-Proxy 代理程序，用于简单的网络铜鼓县你</p>
<ol>
<li>打开ImgGrab 自动扫描jetson与相机设备，使用有不清楚，请查阅 <a href="https://img-grab.com/productinfo/306297.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://img-grab.com/productinfo/306297.html</a> 手册与 ImgGrab用户手册做参考</li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747207/202608/2747207-20260808141453353-416479936.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747207/202608/2747207-20260808141454528-1692780139.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><strong><strong>对比说明</strong></strong></strong></li>
</ol>
<p>相对与MPSOC+NVIDIA ORIN NX，使用纯FPGA+NVIDIA ORIN NX更具性价比，MPSOC需要复杂的PS设置，而ORIN NX 显然已经具备了这个能力，使用MPSOC显得非常冗余和浪费，当然用户如果需要MPSOC PS处理一些其它的实时任务，则令当别论。</p>
<p>星测电子提供完善的CoaXPress 与 Camera Link边缘侧图像采集与AI处理平台，致力于向用书输出广泛兼容、即插即用的软硬件体系。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747207/202608/2747207-20260808141456116-43592153.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747207/202608/2747207-20260808141457934-1426103974.png" class="lazyload"><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2747207/202608/2747207-20260808141459869-5569539.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
